description: Tier 2 of the TADR port's raised limits, peer 6 of ten: 1499 units for the local player, which with its commander is the 1500 cap (owner 0 is always the peer that applies it), one of ten armies on a ring 2800 world units round the centre of Town & Country, all ordered onto the centre. Apply limits-tier2-p0 … p9 one to each peer of a ten-player network game (tools/mp_lobby.sh --map 'Town & Country' …): every peer creates and owns its own units and TA replicates them, so the ten together make 15 000 units, the 15 001-slot design point less one. Even peers field ARM, odd CORE, in tier 1's 12:8:5 mix. The armies are 39-column blocks at 34 world units, so neighbours on the ring stay apart.
